To fast-charge two laptops at 100W each simultaneously, you need a USB-C charger that can deliver at least 200W total, with 100W or more available on each of two USB-C ports at the same time.

The important distinction is that a charger advertised as “200W” doesn't necessarily support 100W + 100W. Some distribute power as 140W + 60W or 100W + 65W when multiple devices are connected.
